description: The length satisfies \(L(c)=\sum_{j<c}\operatorname{sg}(T^j(c))\), where \(\operatorname{sg}(0)=0\) and \(\operatorname{sg}(x)=1\) for \(x>0\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.length_eq_sum (c : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.length c =
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range c, if Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.tails c j = 0 then 0 else 1
